title: Strangers: a silent newcomer in Cullet, noticed by personality and duty
about: docs/STRANGERS.md section 6 and its decisions of 2026-11-12. Cullet's own seed and laws (64 residents; main's sheets, with the two lives of dc2ecfc8: Aldous Quill's stance that arrivals are written, Ingrid Morrow who sees the quay and tells Magda Tarn first). The world starts at 07:00 (every world does; no reducer sets the clock, and 06:30 would cost a 47-minute wait) and its minds live 2.5 game hours. At 09:30 game time (5 real minutes) a scripted newcomer (`newcomer`, the real player reducers with its own non-admin identity) joins at the arrival point, the Counting House yard, and stands silent 5 minutes there; then it walks to the densest group of residents and stands silent 5 minutes; then it stays where it is to the end (20 minutes). It never speaks, gestures or names itself. No arrival laws (rejected). Main's mind defaults (LIVING_GREET=nearest, LIVING_PARK=concurrent). Every line, talk turn, experience row, thought, gesture and position is recorded for arrive_report.py and arrive_spread.py. Followed resident (`subject`, samples and final rows): Aldous Quill.
gradient: Who notices a stranger and what each does about it, by personality and duty (asks, approaches silently, notices inwardly, unaware; tells others), and how soon the first heard line comes.
